notes.title: Patch Release
notes.content:
Several bug fixes and optimizations released some weeks ago, including:
- Faster loading times in loading screen
- No more unlocking achievements by viewing replays
- Skipping "Error uploading" message is now possible by pressing "back"
- Offline Mode is now available (game no longer crashes)
- Added libwebp.so.5 library for archlinux compatibility / yet to be tested
